North Iowa Bulls vs. Granite City Lumberjacks

Description
Cheer on the home team as the North Iowa Bulls hit the ice to take on the Granite City Lumberjacks on Friday, November 6th, at 7:10 PM at the Mason City Arena! Gather your friends and family for an exciting night of hockey, fast-paced action, and hometown fun. Don't miss your chance to catch the Bulls in action! For more information and to purchase tickets, visit https://www.northiowabulls.com/.
